product.title: Small-Group Great Ocean Road Day Trip from Melbourne

description.text: In Melbourne, this max-11 minivan day leaves Mercure Melbourne Southbank or selected city hotels for Apollo Bay, Great Otway National Park wildlife time, the Twelve Apostles, and Loch Ard Gorge. The published format is a smaller vehicle with hotel transfers rather than a 24-seat eco coach. The format suits visitors who want a tighter Great Ocean Road group without a sunset timing. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Melbourne, and the itinerary stays on those Otway and Port Campbell stops that define this outing rather than a Federation Square sports walk.

highlights: Twelve Apostles and Loch Ard Gorge
Great Otway National Park wildlife time

start.description: Please meet your guide at the entrance of Mercure Melbourne Southbank hotel, 9 Riverside Quay, Southbank VIC 3006, Australia, or at a confirmed city-centre hotel pickup.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
